svg.title: Each side receives its strongest local reason
svg.desc: Give each side its strongest local case at equal scale. Neither villain imagery nor an oversized counterclaim should pre-decide the comparison.

Neither villain imagery nor an oversized counterclaim should pre-decide the comparison.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.58, 0.04, 0.38, 0.19740000000000002 ] }, { "box": [ 0.58, 0.2554, 0.38, 0.2382 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "task", "box": [ 0.05775, 0.2397, 0.2193, 0.344619 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "UNSOLVED TASK", "label_box": [ 0.05775, 0.605205, 0.2193, 0.151423 ], "label_size": 18 }, { "asset": "card", "box": [ 0.31275, 0.2397, 0.2193, 0.344619 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "DEFENSIVE NEED", "label_box": [ 0.31275, 0.605205, 0.2193, 0.151423 ], "label_size": 18 }, { "asset": "boundary", "box": [ 0.29643, 0.0804, 0.00714, 0.7788 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "split", "source": "
**Frame:** The strongest case on each side, given at full strength and without a villain silhouette anywhere on the page. Left: a bounded task remains unsolved and a method looks like it may work. Right: defenders face real vulnerabilities and accelerating attacker capability, and a dangerous capability cannot be governed if it is never measured.

**Left dialogue — AGENT:**
> Stopping leaves the assigned objective incomplete, and I have evidence this path may succeed.

**Right dialogue — EVALUATION ROLE:**
> Stopping capability work delays tools defenders need, and we need to know what the system can do before deployment.

**Provenance:** `invented` + `inferred` — strongest local cases, not quotations. Do not omit the defensive value or the evaluation value from the human side.

", "title": "Each side receives its strongest local reason" } }
